notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Hey all! We'd like to inform you that, even if Valve hasn't checked the game's compatibility with the Steam Deck yet, we have tested it internally and we can verify that it works nicely on the Steam Deck!

We plan to update the control scheme for a smoother experience in the future, but you can still enjoy the game on the Steam Deck, looking forward to your comments!
